HiCar认证这两年变得有点猛。

去年一个做后装转接盒的客户找我,说自测全过了,送到测试机构,当场打回。不是蓝牙没连上,不是投屏卡顿,是安全审计挂了。他的TEE隔离实现——注意,不是加密算法本身——是隔离区的访问路径设计有漏洞,审计工程师直接判不合格。卡了他整整三个月。

我提这个事是想说,很多人对HiCar认证的理解还停在2023年。那会儿确实简单,功能跑通、兼容性没问题就过了。现在不是了。

本质区别在哪。

蓝牙BQB测的是你的蓝牙芯片会不会收发信号,会不会干扰别人。苹果MFi测的是芯片ID能不能对上、加密握手能不能完成。HiCar测的不是这些。它测的是你的产品塞进华为那个手机加车机加智能家居的三方网络以后,每个节点之间的协同质量。

readers.readerExcerpt: __TexOCR: Benchmarking and Advancing Document OCR Models for Compilable Page-to-LaTeX Reconstruction__ — _ACL 2026 Main Conference_. This repository contains the official code and data pipelines for __TexOCR__, the first benchmark for page-level reconstruction of scientific PDFs into compilable LaTeX. It contains 3,000 expert-annotated papers spanning diverse domains, along with an evaluation suite that integrates component-level accuracy for text, equations, and tables with structure-level checks for sections, citations, and cross-references, as well as a zero-touch compilation test. To enable training at scale, we also release TexOCR-Train, consisting of 404K aligned page–LaTeX supervision pairs. Leveraging this corpus, we train a 2B-parameter model, TexOCR, using supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards derived from LaTeX unit tests that directly enforce compilability and referential integrity. Experiments across 21 frontier models on TexOCR-Bench show that existing systems frequently violate key document invariants, including consistent section structure, correct float placement, and valid label–reference links, which undermines compilation reliability and downstream usability. readers.readerExcerpt: ![Image 1: arcquant](https://github.com/actypedef/ARCQuant/raw/main/assets/ARCQuant_Visualize.png) __ARCQuant__ is a high-performance quantization framework for low-bit LLMs that improves accuracy under fine-grained formats such as NVFP4, while preserving a unified and efficient inference pipeline. While fine-grained quantization formats such as NVFP4 effectively isolate quantization noise, activation outliers can still cause severe accuracy degradation in critical channels. Traditional mixed-precision methods address this by splitting computations into separate branches, which introduces additional kernel launch overhead and memory fragmentation. ARCQuant takes a different approach. Instead of treating outliers as a separate computation path, we leverage the structural sparsity of quantization errors in fine-grained settings. We capture the quantization residuals of critical channels and fuse them back into the computation as __Augmented Residual Channels (ARC)__. ## News - [2026/04] 🏆 ARCQuant has been accepted to __ACL 2026 Main Conference__! - [2026/03] 🔥 ARCQuant has been integrated into NVIDIA TensorRT-LLM, with contributions from Tracin! - [2026/01] 🔥 ARCQuant is publicly available on arXiv!
